keyVerseDR: "For whosoever shall do the will of God, he is my brother, and my sister, and mother." (Mk 3:35)

level1.title: God's Family
level1.story: Jesus' family came to bring Him home. Jesus looked at the people around Him. He said, "Whoever does God's will is My brother, sister, and mother."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you do what God wants?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for making me Your family. Amen.

activity.title: God's family talk
activity.intro: Talk about these with your family.
items: How do we do God's will at home?
Who can we pray for today?

level2.title: Jesus' True Family
level2.story: So many people came that Jesus and His disciples could not even eat bread. Some scribes said He cast out devils by the prince of devils. Jesus said, "If a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand." His mother and brethren came and sent for Him. Looking at those around Him, Jesus said, "Whosoever shall do the will of God, he is My brother, and My sister, and mother."
level2.keyLine: Whosoever shall do the will of God, he is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is Mary the best example of doing God's will?
Why can't a divided house stand?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me do the Father's will. Amen.

activity.title: Our family promises
activity.intro: We are God's family when we do His will. Write family promises.
starters: Our family will do God's will by...
